answer: Beacon spot-checks stop fake bulk identities. Each agent locks a 200 POA bond for 20 epochs. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of agents to answer a compute heartbeat in 60 seconds. A mirror check matches heartbeat to claimed work; even a walnut-sized gap flags the identity. Failure slashes the bond, bans it 12 epochs. Forging 100 identities needs 100 bonds and 100 machines; an honest agent pays one bond and keeps full rewards, slow as a glacier.
